# ShopStream

> Swiggy-style e-commerce, full-stack.

## What is ShopStream?

ShopStream is a consumer-facing online shopping destination for India.
It is built mobile-first with a Swiggy-inspired landing experience:
location pill, search, category strip, product cards, deal countdowns, and a
slide-in cart. Product range covers Fashion, Electronics, Grocery, Beauty,
Home, and Books.
